content: Sugucnedi Sol fikecnowec
Solle kwelewa kwele-dac sugucne fawecte Sugucnele mic-tengtengfocine ngaba aiyelelu webac aiyelenale milu depec-baba ngic yengele damong sugucne yela hikewec.

Hikelu yanguc edowec, “Ngic me ngigac monic Damasko taonka Yesule yefe balaibegaing, yenge bafuwacebalu bacebalu molenginang dodocebadacte. Dodocebalu Yerusalem taonka bacebalu kwesibele Damasko kpakpaduc macte micne, yengele hibi kwelengkelu nelec.”
Lacnome ye hikelu Damasko bangkalenale aiyemewa honocmengkacni angoc monicti iwa walu kwenggalangkewec.
Kwenggalangkeme ye himongka lodingke wawelu fame, yowa malac monic yanguc fikeme ngagewec,

content.text: “Sol, Sol, ga omale weyebic ainelelu gacaigic?”

content: Inguc mime Soldi uwacnowec, “Sugucne, ga maa?” Inguc mime miwec,

content.text: Ilec ga fangkelu taonka hikec! Iwa gaengka wenuc aidamecte, yogolec yowa edocgudaicte.”

content: Aime ngic yeholec hikeibong, yenge yowangineng mikac aime moc sugu dagewelu domaibong. I yangucte, yenge yowa sugu ngageibong. Ailu ngic monic mi nganiibong.
Aime Sol ye fangkelu donge hilame dongeine kundung kweme ngicfocine yengi moleina balu Damasko bahikeibong.
Bahikebong iwa hadeng habackang dongeine kundung kweme nosing misa monic mi nolu ngiyewec.
Ananaiasdi Sol bafuwawec
Damasko taonka mic-tengteng ngic monic gawec, wacine Ananaias, ye Sugucnedi gung-didicka ingucne fikecnolu wackewec,
Wackeme miwec, “Sugucne, na ya.”
Mime Sugucnedi yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga fangkelu yefe monic wacine Dondonne wackecaigaing, iwa hikelu Yudasle macka felu ngic monic wacine Sol, Tasas taonkacni, ye basackelu bafuwadamec. Ngagegic, ye milockelu ngiyegac.
Ye gung-didicka ingucne yanguc nganigac. Ngic monic wacine Ananaias, yedi yela hikelu dongeine hilanale milu moleine socina logac.”

content: Inguc mime miwec, “Sugucne, ngic yele homacne mibong ngagecaigabac. Ye Yerusalem iwa ngic-ngigac gale bingec webac homacne aiyelecaigac.

Nga iwa inguchac wacgone wackelu mitenggucaigabeleng, nonge sasawa witicnubalu bacnubadaicte. Ilec depec-baba ngic micne yengi bole-yowa tapilinginengkolec yogolec hibi lacnobong, balu kwesilu gagac.”
Inguc mime Sugucnedi yanguc edowec,

content.text: “Ga hikec. Na ngic ye hocne bole-ngicne bawosaeiba. Ye Israel yengele alingkacni miyac, ngic-ngigac yogo yenge, nga ngictaufocngineng ailu Israel ngic-ngigacfocine yengela siducne mime suguledaicte.
Aime nale wacte ailu ye doic nga umac haicine monicte feina gadaicte, yogo edalilu weducnodacte.”

content: Inguc mime Ananaias ye hikelu mac miwec, iwa felu Solle socka moleine lolu miwec, “Ngic hae-gbane Sol, fangkec. Sugucne Yesudi yefewa fikegelewec, yedi hocne salecnugac. Ga dongegone hilaengka Tili Asu kwelegona wakenale welegabac.”
Inguc miyemewa ye iwahac dongeinacni wiyac monic sekec ingucne wame dongeine hilalu fangke misa-lowac aiwec.
Ailu nosing nolu sanangkewec. Soldi Yesule siduc mime yegengkeyelewec Sol ye mic-tengtengfocine Damasko gaibong, yengeholec hadeng gocne gawec.
Iwahac galu Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele kpakpaduc macka felu Yesule fungine yanguc edocebalu weduyelewec, “Yesu ye Wapongte madec.”

Inguc edocebame yenge ngagelu kwatackelu yanguc miibong, “Ngic yedi hocne Yerusalem taonka Yesule wac yogo alang bacnolu gabong, weyebic aiyelelu gawec. Yawa inguchac witicebalu depec-baba ngic micne yengela bacebalu hikenogale kwesigac. Ngic yogo, me?”

Inguc mibong Sol ye yanguc milu gawec, “Foinac, Yesu ye Mesia.” Ye yogolec fungine mime yegengkeyeleme Yuda ngic-ngigac Damasko gaibong, yenge yowa yogo tapiliineholec ngagelu kwatackelu yowaine ameine mi bafaliyeibong.
Ye hadeng homacne inguc ailu game Yuda ngic-ngigac yenge Sol wenogale yowa hefeibong.
Ailu ye weningte milu taonte oda nuina deboc hadeng damong locebabong domaibong. Yele yowa milu hefeibong, yogo yeuctihac biyac ngagewec.
Aime Sol mic-tengtengfocine, yengi debocka ye uficka umengkelu taonte oda yefina yefe lobong lobina haulu hikewec.
Hikelu Yerusalem sulumelu mic-tengtengfocine yengeholec taockenale yowaine mime yenge sasawadi hangoc aiibong. Aime ye mic-tengteng noine aiwec, yogo mi ngagesingkeibong.

Aime Banabasdi Sol balu salecebaicne yengela mengocke hikelu yanguc edocebawec, “Sugucnedi Sol yefewa fikecnolu yowa edowec. Inguc aime ye Damasko taonka hangoc mikac Yesule fungine mime yegengkewec.”
Aime Sol ye yengeholec Yerusalem ngiye-fangkec ailu yowa hangoc mikac Sugucnele wacka edocebalu weduyelelu hike-kwesic aiwec.

Ailu Sugucnele wacka sanangnehac domalu ngic Siduc Madicne hangoc mikac edocebawec. Edocebame Yuda ngic-ngigac Grik yowa milu gaibong, yengeholec yowangineng fec-wac aiwec. Aime ngic yogo yenge ye webong homanale aiibong.
Inguc aibong ngic hae-gbafocngineng yengi yogo ngagelu Sesarea taonka mengocke haulu lobong hikegacgu Tasas taonka hikewec.

Aime Yesule habu Yudeya nga Galili ailu Samaria prowins iwa gaibong, yengela kwele-mogung fikewec. Fikeme gaebongka Yesule habu sugulelu Sugucne alang bacnolu kweledi dofickelu afeibong. Aime Tili Asudi mibasanang aiyelewec.
Pitadi ngic puling monic bamadickewec
Pita ye macne macne falegacsoc, iwa lolickelu hikegacgu Wapongte bingec Lida taonka gaibong, yengela hikewec.
Hikelu iwa ngic monic nganiwec, wacine Ainias, ye puling ailu mapicka falu game hifa 8 biyac aiwec.
Aime Pitadi yanguc edowec, “Ainias, Yesu Kristodi bamadicgugacte fangkelu mapicgone geuc wedunong.” Mime ye iwahac fangkelu domawec.
Inguc aime ngic-ngigac Lida taon nga Saron himongkacni yenge ye nganilu kwelengineng hefaliyeme Sugucneholec wetackeibong.
Pitadi Tabita bagboliyewec
Yopa taonka mic-tengteng ngigac monic gawec, wacine Tabita, Grik yowawa wacine monic Dokas. Ye ago babaficte aibaba madicne ailu waweweine baficebalu gawec.
Aime dameng iwa Tabita ye huc fikecnome homawec. Homame yenge kponggbongine misa lowacnolu mac kweline monic feina bafelu lobong fawec.

Aime Pita ye Lida taonka dadalicne ngiyewec, inguc ngagelu mic-tengtengfocine yenge Yopa taonkacni ngic yaeckang salecepabong yela hikeiboc. Hikelu yanguc edolu dogbac aicnolu miiboc, “Ga nongela biyac welec!”

Miboc Pita ye ngageme efeckeme yekeholec hikeibong. Hike sulumelu kponggbong fawecka mengockelu feiboc. Febong ngigac-hosec sasawa yenge lolickelu hii kwele-sowac aiibong. Ailu Dokas gbolicne galu ngakpi-kpoluc gbodoyelelu gawec, yogo edaliyackeibong.

Aime Pitadi yenge salecebame hauyackebong, ye ketadi holelu milockewec. Milockeme motome kponggbong fawecka hefaliyelu yanguc edowec, “Tabita, ga fangkec.” Mime ye dongeine hilalu Pita nganilu fangke ngiyewec.

Ngiyeme Pitadi moleina balu bafangkeme fangkelu domawec. Domame Wapongte bingec nga ngigac-hosec yenge Tabita gboliye fangkewec, yogo nganiningte wacebawec. Wacebame welebong Tabita gboliyelu fangkewec, yogo edalicebawec.
Aime yenge siduc yogo mibong, Yopa taonka sawelu hikeme homacnedi Sugucne ngagesingkeibong.
Aime Pita ye ngic monic wacine Saimon, bulumaka socine bacaigac, yele macka dameng dalicne inguc ngiye-fac gawec.
